items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: He was with Gene Goldcat. But I didn't know who he was at the time. I only had the pleasure of meeting him within the last few years, when I became associated with Tom Brown...

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you remember many other people playing that style here, of slapping the bass?

No. I remember hearing Tom Brown's brother. He was with Gene Goldcat. But I didn't know who he was at the time. I only had the pleasure of meeting him within the last few years, when I became associated with Tom Brown through the New Orleans Jazz Club. And not many years before Tom passed away, his brother visited here, and then I was able to meet him. Yeah. He played that same style. He played that style. And he was given credit, I think, for being a man that started that. Yes. In fact, I read that in a…
I remember Tom showed us that article.
